title: T4 End-to-End Audit: Confirm Zero Activation Rate and Document Blocker Chain
objective: Run a multi-day simulation using the real world generator (not synthetic fixtures) and confirm that T4 qualifying event detection is never triggered. Trace every code-level gate that prevents T4 from producing a negative relational signal, cross-day residual, or wake-chain output. Produce a structured written audit report that names each blocker in execution order so that Phase P32 implementation tasks have a precise target list.
exact_scope: Audit the live T4 path from world snapshot generation through `_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event`, the wake-chain gate at line 1820, `_adjust_t4`, and residual creation — all within the standard `simulate_day_bridged` call path. The audit must use the real `get_world_snapshot` generator (no injected social_event fixtures) to confirm zero activation in real simulation. The report must state each blocker, its file and approximate line, and why it prevents downstream progress.
constraints: Do not modify vision.md, road_map.md, or decisions_summary.md
Do not expand deferred ticks T3/T5/T6/T7/T8
Do not alter existing engine contracts or AppraisalSignal field definitions
Do not introduce new features or implementation changes — this is a read-and-diagnose task only
Audit must use the real get_world_snapshot generator, not hand-crafted WorldSnapshot fixtures, to confirm production-path activation rate
The audit script must not modify any shared state or write to production data
acceptance_criteria: A multi-day simulation (minimum 10 consecutive world days, days 3–12) is run using the real world generator and the T4 activation rate is confirmed to be 0.0 — every day emits an audit record with activated=False
The audit report identifies Blocker 1: `get_world_snapshot` in `back/app/world/generator.py` never sets `social_event` on the returned `WorldSnapshot` — the field is always None
The audit report identifies Blocker 2: `_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event` in `tick_bridge.py` returns None on every real simulation day because `world.social_event is None`

The audit report identifies Blocker 3: because no qualifying event is detected, `build_signal_from_t4_relationship_tick` always returns a positive-valence / mild_increase signal — the negative branch is structurally unreachable

The audit report identifies Blocker 4: the wake-chain gate (`_t4_wake_chain_gate_open`) at tick_bridge.py line ~1820 requires `valence==negative` and `trust_shift in (mild_decrease, strong_decrease)`, conditions that are never satisfied in the positive-only default path

The audit report identifies Blocker 5: because the wake-chain gate never opens, no relational residual with aftershock_days=1 is ever created, which means the bootstrapping deadlock persists — `_adjust_t4` is never called with a non-None residual in real simulation

The audit report states the exact bootstrapping deadlock: T4 can only produce a negative residual if the wake-chain gate opens, but the gate can only open if the signal is already negative, which requires either a qualifying social event (Blocker 1) or a carried negative residual (which never exists because no residual is ever created)
The audit output is a structured file (JSON, Markdown, or Python dataclass dump) that can be referenced by subsequent implementation rounds
All existing tests continue to pass after the audit script and report are added
required_tests: A pytest test or standalone audit script runs `simulate_day_bridged` for at least 10 consecutive days using the real `get_world_snapshot` output (no injected social_event) and asserts that `T4ActivationAuditRecord.activated` is False for every day — confirming production-path activation rate is 0.0
The audit collects `T4ActivationAuditRecord` objects and asserts none have `trigger_event_type` set to a non-None value
The audit verifies that `world.social_event` is None for every WorldSnapshot returned by `get_world_snapshot` across the simulated day range
non_goals: Do not fix any of the identified blockers — only document them
Do not add social_event production to the world generator
Do not implement the T4 wake-chain activation or residual creation logic
Do not add new SocialEventSpec fixtures or modify arc/fallback phase data
Do not change any test that is currently passing
deliverables: back/tests/test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py — a pytest module that drives real-world-generator simulation and asserts zero activation across the day range

docs/p32_t4_blocker_audit.md — a written audit report listing each blocker in execution order with file path, approximate line reference, and a plain-language explanation of why the blocker prevents downstream T4 relational output
out_of_scope: Any implementation changes to the T4 path
Adding social_event generation to the world generator or arcs
Modifying AppraisalSignal fields or settlement logic
Expanding bridge coverage for deferred ticks
